verdict.summary: The prior execution-context blocker is resolved. Live reverification now runs in the separate publish job, where no target-controlled code has executed, and its verifier, driver, and dynamically loaded policy sibling are all rebound to pre-model SHA-256 outputs before execution. Publication additionally requires a non-empty positive attestation emitted only after reverify returns successfully. The earlier pre-shell LD_PRELOAD persistence path from the hostile gate runner therefore no longer reaches the verifier process. The claim receipt ordering and newest-receipt check are fail-closed, including malformed timestamps, ties, missing ownership, foreign supersession, and the pre-attempt race. The added tests exercise accepting and rejecting paths and the real rendered verification block, so they are non-vacuous. No blocker or major issue remains in the diff.
